component.name: SoraFy
component.summary: High-fidelity music streaming player with MPD, AI MCP & Jam Remote

description.p: SoraFy is a modern music player built for audiophiles, power users, and everyday listeners. It matches songs with lossless and high-quality streams without requiring user account logins.

ul.li: Universal playlist importing from Spotify and Apple Music
Millisecond-synchronized synchronized lyrics powered by LRCLIB
Native Linux MPD (Music Player Daemon) server on port 6600
AI Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude & Cursor on port 8800
Local Wi-Fi Jam remote playback controller on port 4120

description.p: SoraFy 2.0.0 initial multiplatform release featuring MPD daemon, AI MCP support, and Jam Remote.
